Struct TypeDefinitions and aliases lower to #[repr(C)] Rust records on demand; layouts that differ from natural repr(C) (packed/aligned), bitfields, anonymous members, volatile/atomic fields, and unions stay barriers. structs.c and new record_types.c pass; nested_structs.c moved to 3.16 (needs aggregate init). ValueKind::Aggregate lowers for structs and fixed arrays: complete in-order aggregates become struct/array literals; zero_fill or partial ones become a block that zeroes a temp then assigns each designated member. GNU ranges and unions remain barriers. Uninitialized arrays of non-scalar elements use mem::zeroed. All named fixtures pass plus nested_structs, pointer_compare_address, array_one_past_end_bound, new aggregate_zero_fill. uchar_conversions moved to 3.17 (mbstate_t contains a union).

Incremental coverage is in place: the slate nextest profile runs tests/fixtures plus c-testsuite, gcc-torture, and gcc-dg through the slate frontend against a native C oracle, with supported/unsupported ratchets and per-suite triage reports. FileCheck enforcement is intentionally suspended and slate-frontend rewrites are not enabled yet; both are tracked by the crate workflow rather than this phase.

Non-string globals lower to static mut with constant initializers (constants, conversions, aggregates of those) or mem::zeroed; extern declarations go in the extern "C" block. Accesses wrap unsafe, array decay of a static uses addr_of_mut!, locals/params that share a static's name are renamed. TLS, symbol attributes, volatile/atomic, and non-ABI alignment stay barriers. Named fixtures pass plus logical_ops and new global_shadow_extern; 184 more corpus/local tests promoted.
